# Assumption of Moses Chapter 6 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Wicked Kings and Roman Rule

---

**1** Then powerful kings will arise over them, and they will call themselves priests of the Most High God.

**2** They will commit great iniquity in the holy of holies.

**3** Then will arise an insolent king who is not of priestly lineage, a reckless and wicked man.

**4** He will judge them as they deserve.

**5** He will burn their city, smash the altars, and carry away silver and gold.

**6** He will drive out those who live in it, and will take captives with him.

**7** He will put to death both old men and young men and will have no mercy on them.

**8** Then fear and trembling of this king will come upon them.

**9** And he will take them as plunder.

**10** He will ravage their land for thirty-four years.

**11** He will chastise them and afflict them.

**12** And that man himself will be carried off to Egypt and will die there.

**13** For the Lord will punish him with the punishment of captivity.

**14** After him another king will arise, his son, similar to him, who will reign for a short time.

**15** He will afflict the people with all kinds of grievous punishments.

**16** He will rule them for thirty-four years.

**17** In his days his sons will be in conflict with one another, and all will be corrupt.

**18** Then a mighty king of the earth's kings will come against them and will rule over them.

**19** He will crucify those who confess their circumcision.

**20** He will torture those who deny it and compel them to abandon the holy law.

**21** He will torture the wise men among them and will force them to denounce themselves.
